data.title: Pilot 0 installs kadence from npm pack of the working tree, not from a 0.4.2 release
data.why: The owner installs Pilot 0 in person, and the tarball carries the --rejected crash fix plus the whole second-author path; a 0.4.2 would ship the fix without the path and then be replaced within weeks. A public release is still needed before anyone installs without the owner, and that is 0.5.0.
data.rejected: Publish 0.4.2 now with only the crash fix
